title: little band
summary: A needle drops on a record and three round birds join in, one instrument at a time: guitar, drum, piano. Thirty seconds, animated in Python and rendered in Blender.
medium: 3d animated music video, python + blender (eevee), video

specs.shots: 5: the record player, the guitar, the drum, the piano keys, the whole room
specs.renderer: Blender 5.0, EEVEE with ray tracing, run headless from one Python file
specs.animation: no keyframes: every frame is posed by code from the time alone
specs.models: all built in code, no imported assets
specs.music: generated with ElevenLabs Music from a five-section plan, 80 bpm
specs.sync: to the beat, not to the notes: plucks, hops and hi-hat taps land on a 0.75 second grid measured from the track
specs.controls: click for sound, then click or space to pause, ← → skip 5 s, m mutes
specs.inspired by: the Blender music video by @kevin_t_ngo, posted on X (the format only: instruments in a warm room, animated in Python; the characters, room and music are new)
